title: Coordinator status envelope
description: What every coordinator prints when asked where a run is. One shape across all of them, so a wrapper can read the phase and the next action without knowing which coordinator it called. Anything specific to one coordinator lives under `detail`, which keeps the shared surface stable as a coordinator gains state.

kind.description: Which coordinator produced this, so a caller can find `detail`'s contract.

phase.description: Null when no phase remains, which is how a caller distinguishes a finished run from one waiting on work.

phases.description: Every phase this run will walk, in order.

resource.description: The contract the current phase answers to. Null only when no phase remains.

next_action.description: What to do now, in one sentence. The field an agent acts on, so it names the command rather than describing the situation.

detail.description: Coordinator-specific state. Open by design: a coordinator adds its own keys here without changing the shared envelope.
